findings.title: Directive parse assumes a single policy per header value
findings.evidence: HtmlViewerRegion.tsx:211-215 splits on ';' only; a comma-merged multi-policy value ('sandbox, default-src ...') yields first token 'sandbox,' and is rejected.
findings.consequence: Only if a fronting proxy adds a second CSP header would a served file read as absent; unreachable in current loopback dev/demo setup.
